note: BH-8123. bin/fly-pool-tick.sh counts hub pool ticks in a row that find no flyctl. Past this many, ONE ALERTS line (--id pool-noflyctl-streak) per episode; a tick that finds flyctl ends the episode. Settings row `lane.fly-pool-tick.pool_noflyctl_alert_ticks`. 0 means off: no streak alert (bin/fly-pool.sh keeps its once-a-day per-project alert).
